The Special Theory of Relativity is founded on two fundamental postulates proposed by Albert Einstein in 1905:

1. **The Principle of Relativity (First Postulate):** The laws of physics are the same in all inertial frames of reference. No preferred inertial frame exists.

2. **The Constancy of the Speed of Light (Second Postulate):** The speed of light in vacuum ($c$) is constant for all observers, regardless of the motion of the source or the observer.
